keyPoints.en: Hardwood (broad-leaved): chengal, meranti, teak. Softwood (conifer): pine. Grouping is botanical, not by hardness.
keyPoints.bm: Kayu keras (berdaun lebar): cengal, meranti, jati. Kayu lembut (konifer): pain. Pengelasan secara botani, bukan kekerasan.
Papan buatan: papan lapis (lapisan), MDF (gentian), papan serpai (serpihan).

keyPoints.en: Ferrous (iron, can rust): mild steel, cast iron, stainless steel. Non-ferrous: aluminium, copper, brass.
keyPoints.bm: Ferus (besi, boleh berkarat): keluli lembut, besi tuang, keluli tahan karat. Bukan ferus: aluminium, kuprum, loyang.

keyPoints.en: Thermoplastics reshape with heat (acrylic, PVC); thermosets do not (melamine, epoxy).
keyPoints.bm: Termoplastik boleh dibentuk semula dengan haba (akrilik, PVC); termoset tidak (melamin, epoksi).

keyPoints.en: Try square (90°), steel rule, tenon saw, coping saw (curves), hacksaw (metal), file, G-clamp, hand drill.
keyPoints.bm: Sesiku L (90°), pembaris keluli, gergaji tenon, gergaji koping (lengkungan), gergaji besi (logam), kikir, pengapit G, gerudi tangan.

keyPoints.en: Safety: goggles, apron, tie back hair, clamp work, never run, follow instructions.
keyPoints.bm: Keselamatan: gogal, apron, ikat rambut, kapit bahan, jangan berlari, ikut arahan.

tip.en: Choose a material by matching its properties to the specification.
tip.bm: Pilih bahan dengan memadankan sifatnya dengan spesifikasi.
